claims.title: Finite semigroup law
claims.normalized_claim: Finite real/complex matrix A; real s,t; exponential multiplication and left/right derivative formulas.
claims.audit_argument: Absolutely convergent series; binomial Cauchy product; local uniform differentiation.
claims.boundary_review: s=0,t=0; negative times; zero-dimensional space.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Packet semigroup convolution
claims.normalized_claim: Finite complete algebraically orthogonal projector family; every packet block of exp((s+t)A) equals intermediate-block convolution.
claims.audit_argument: 1.2 and insertion of sum P=I; no self-adjointness required.
claims.boundary_review: One packet; zero packet; zero-dimensional space.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Reducing packets
claims.normalized_claim: All off-diagonal generator blocks vanish; all off-diagonal exponential blocks vanish.
claims.audit_argument: A=sum P_a A P_a and every A power has the same block structure.
claims.boundary_review: Zero blocks; t=0; algebraic idempotents need not be orthogonal in a Hilbert inner product.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Exact Duhamel refinement identity
claims.normalized_claim: Rectangular C and finite generators; t>=0; Ce^(tAf)-e^(tAc)C is integral of coarse exponential, CAf-AcC, fine exponential.
claims.audit_argument: Differentiate exp((t-r)Ac) C exp(rAf); integrate endpoint difference.
claims.boundary_review: Rectangular dimensions; t=0; sign of defect.
claims.dependency_graph: Finite exponential differentiation and ordinary vector-valued FTC.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Norm bound
claims.normalized_claim: Under the two stated semigroup norm bounds, Duhamel defect obeys the printed convolution norm bound; contraction case <=t||Delta||.
claims.audit_argument: Submultiplicativity, triangle inequality for integral, 3.1.
claims.boundary_review: Equal/unequal growth exponents; zero time; compatible induced norms.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Resolvent refinement identity
claims.normalized_claim: z in both resolvent sets; rectangular resolvent defect is Rc Delta Rf.
claims.audit_argument: Multiplying by zI-Ac on left and zI-Af on right leaves Delta.
claims.boundary_review: Noncommuting matrices; non-square C; both inverse hypotheses necessary.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Finite Markov semigroup
claims.normalized_claim: Finite real Metzler Q with zero column sums; exp(tQ) is column stochastic for t>=0.
claims.audit_argument: Shift Q by lambda I to a nonnegative matrix; power series gives positivity; differentiate column sums.
claims.boundary_review: Q=0; lambda=0; column convention rather than row convention.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Exact lumpability
claims.normalized_claim: CK=Kbar C implies CK^n=Kbar^n C for every natural n.
claims.audit_argument: Induction uses literal rectangular products; stochasticity unnecessary to algebraic implication.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Finite-horizon defect formula
claims.normalized_claim: Arbitrary one-step defect gives finite telescoping sum; contractions give <=n||Delta||.
claims.audit_argument: Adjacent summands telescope in correct order; triangle/submultiplicative norm estimate.
claims.boundary_review: n=0 gives empty sum; n=1 gives Delta; no commutation silently used.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Finite conditional-expectation projector
claims.normalized_claim: Finite strictly positive weights and partition; weighted averaging is idempotent, weighted self-adjoint, with block-constant range.
claims.audit_argument: Block mass positive; explicit blockwise inner-product expansion; block constants fixed.
claims.boundary_review: Singleton block; one block; complex conjugation convention.
claims.dependency_graph: Positive block masses and finite sums.

claims.title: Tower law and martingale packets
claims.normalized_claim: Nested finite partitions yield PcPf=PfPc=Pc; adjacent projector differences multiply orthogonally and reconstruct Pr.
claims.audit_argument: Both averaging identities; P_i P_j=P_min(i,j); algebraic expansion.
claims.boundary_review: r=0; repeated adjacent partition; terminal Pr need not be full identity.

claims.title: Independent-likelihood composition
claims.normalized_claim: Nonnegative likelihoods with positive first and combined evidence; sequential Bayesian update equals product-likelihood update.
claims.audit_argument: First normalizer cancels; second evidence equals combined/first.
claims.boundary_review: Likelihood zeros allowed; combined positive evidence is essential.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Bayesian packet reconstruction
claims.normalized_claim: Positive total evidence; posterior is sum of evidence-normalized packet masses times conditional packet vectors.
claims.audit_argument: Positive packets cancel local normalizer; zero local evidence forces every nonnegative summand zero.
claims.boundary_review: Zero-evidence packets contribute zero vector and are not probability distributions.
claims.dependency_graph: Nonnegative finite summands and Bayesian definition.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Likelihood perturbation bound
claims.normalized_claim: Fixed probability prior; two nonnegative likelihoods with positive evidence; printed minimum-evidence L1 bound.
claims.audit_argument: Add/subtract common-denominator term; evidence difference bounded by weighted absolute difference.
claims.boundary_review: Zero coordinates allowed; small evidence enlarges bound. Printed min denominator is valid, though looser than the strongest symmetric bound.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Exact effective-likelihood factorization
claims.normalized_claim: Finite partition; positive fine evidence; coarsened posterior equals Bayesian update with conditional effective coarse likelihood.
claims.audit_argument: For P_a>0 divide packet evidence by P_a; for P_a=0 both weighted terms vanish.
claims.boundary_review: Zero prior-mass packet and arbitrary value assigned there.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Bayesian refinement criterion
claims.normalized_claim: At least two nonempty coarse packets; strictly positive fine/coarse likelihoods; all-prior commutation iff lambda_i=c*lambda_bar_a for one c>0.
claims.audit_argument: Two-state priors compare posterior odds across packets; hidden redistributions force constancy within packet; common ratio propagates.
claims.boundary_review: One-packet exception; singleton fibers; strict positivity used in odds.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Bayesian information-loss packet
claims.normalized_claim: Nonnegative fine/coarse likelihoods and both evidences positive; exact information-loss factorization, scale null direction, and two L1 bounds.
claims.audit_argument: Subtract normalized vectors; P^T delta is evidence change; factor annihilates declared likelihood; apply 7.3 and conditional-average triangle inequality.
claims.boundary_review: Zero-mass packets; global scale null direction is at declared likelihood, not every perturbation direction.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Nested Bayesian packet tower
claims.normalized_claim: Nested finite tower, positive likelihoods; adjacent nontrivial criteria and singleton exceptions imply all composite Bayesian squares commute.
claims.audit_argument: Apply 8.2 at every nontrivial step; singleton posterior equals1; compose equal maps.
claims.boundary_review: Tower with singleton coarse level; repeated or equal partitions.

claims.title: Canonical coarsest likelihood-resolving partition
claims.normalized_claim: Finite likelihood family; equality-profile quotient is unique coarsest likelihood-resolving partition, and under positivity with >=2 classes coarsest nontrivial all-prior closed partition.
claims.audit_argument: Profile equality is equivalence relation; every resolving partition refines it; 8.2 characterizes nontrivial all-prior closure.
claims.boundary_review: Identical profiles: one class; excluded uniqueness of coarsest nontrivial partition. Empty family also belongs to this boundary.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

claims.title: Fractional refinement towers

claims.audit_argument: Positive semigroup, derivative of column mass, integrate logS; monotonic limit and improper FTC give mass.

claims.title: Naturality under exact intertwining
claims.normalized_claim: Finite complex matrices Af,Ac and rectangular C with C Af=Ac C; common holomorphic F on neighborhood of union of spectra; canonical spectral-jet calculus commutes with C.
claims.audit_argument: Intertwining maps maximal generalized eigenspaces; powers intertwine; use common cutoff >=both dimensions; uniqueness of direct-sum-defined operator. Local Cauchy circles recover coefficients.
claims.boundary_review: Unequal/zero dimensions, nilpotent Jordan parts, disconnected holomorphic neighborhood; no single Taylor disk assumption. Analyticity needed for holomorphic interpretation, while algebraic jet naturality is more general.
claims.dependency_graph: CanonicalJets -> HolomorphicFinite; real matrices via manually reviewed complexification, not separately compiled construction.
claims.evidence_label: fresh manual proof and scope audit; historical pinned Lean certification only

conjectures.title: Transfer-semigroup realization
conjectures.obligation: Specify sufficiently regular, topology, domain/closure, generator/evolution-family compatibility. No general generation proof is present.

conjectures.title: Uniform refinement control
conjectures.obligation: Resolution-independent semigroup bounds and inverse-limit hypotheses are not supplied merely by finite Duhamel identities. Physically meaningful is not a formal class.

conjectures.title: Latent-packet closure
conjectures.obligation: Specify infinite packet state space, stable topology, limiting self-energy, admissibility/realizability, and whether added state packets are allowed. Finite formulas do not establish this universal equivalence.

migration.claim: Bounded A on complex Banach space; Spec(A) contained in simply connected open region on which D_N has no zeros; fix branch g=log D_N. Then S_N^(r)(A)=exp(-r*g(A))=(D_N^-r)(A), group law in r; finite bounded idempotent packet sandwich commutes with holomorphic contour integral.

The historical source cites Dunford-Schwartz 1958; exact external-source edition/theorem not independently authenticated in this core audit.
